role: Per-dimension rules shared by client and server: the light-to-brightness table, the sun and moon angle and phase, sunrise and fog colours, which chunk generator and biome source the dimension uses, the spawn-point checks, and flags such as hasNoSky and canRespawnHere. The overworld uses these defaults.
scope_reason: Every dimension's tick and frame read it (skylight, spawning brightness, celestial angle, spawn point).

members.name: moonPhaseFactors
members.note: Used through World.getCurrentMoonPhaseFactor for the spawn local difficulty.

members.name: worldObj
members.note: Back pointer; native passes the world explicitly.

members.name: terrainType
members.note: Always DEFAULT in this game; FLAT branches are never taken.

members.name: field_82913_c
members.note: Flat-world options only.

members.name: worldChunkMgr
members.note: Biome source; the overworld's is layers.c, the Nether and End use a single biome (nether.h, end.h). Indexed under the biome records.

members.name: isHellWorld
members.note: Native tests dim == -1 (e.g. ticks.c lava rate, features_springs.c).

members.name: lightBrightnessTable
members.note: Also carried as rs_out lbt in renderstate.h for frames.

members.name: registerWorld
members.note: Wiring; the native world's dim and no_sky are set before the first chunk loads.

members.name: generateLightBrightnessTable
members.note: Computed per call rather than tabled.

members.name: registerWorldChunkManager
members.note: Selects the biome source; native selects by dim at chunk generation.

members.name: createChunkGenerator
members.note: Selects ChunkProviderGenerate; the generators are indexed under world/gen (chunkgen.c, nether.c, end.c).

members.name: canCoordinateBeSpawn
members.note: The overworld's grass-top test inside WorldServer.createSpawnPosition's fuzz loop, over sw_top_block.

members.name: calculateCelestialAngle
members.note: Frame side: renderstate.c:rs_celestial.

members.name: getMoonPhase
members.note: Frame-side moon phase texture selection not verified.

members.name: isSurfaceWorld
members.note: Only read by client-side clock and compass rendering and the sky renderer; native keys those off dim. No explicit counterpart found.; not a gap (triage 2026-09-25)

members.name: canRespawnHere
members.note: Also activate.h can_respawn (bed use) and sleep.c.

members.name: getProviderForDimension
members.note: Factory; native uses dim directly.

members.name: getCloudHeight
members.note: clouds are off in every oracle run: GameSettings.shouldRenderClouds needs the clouds option, which Main.optionsFor sets from a replay's tape header and otherwise false (the fixed render profile, DEVLOG 2026-09-24), and no tape turns it on; RenderGlobal.hasCloudFog is always false, so EntityRenderer's cloud fog never asks either. Native play draws clouds by default (play.c play_clouds), with no oracle frame to judge them

members.name: isSkyColored
members.note: Client sky renderer switch; raster.c branches on dimension instead. Not verified member by member.; not a gap (triage 2026-09-25)

members.name: getEntrancePortalLocation
members.note: null for the overworld; see WorldProviderEnd.

members.name: getAverageGroundLevel
members.note: 64 for the overworld (seedworld.c, temple_blocks.c comment); 50 for the End.

members.name: getWorldHasVoidParticles
members.note: csrc/play/play.c sets voidp = (view_dim == 0); no named counterpart in csrc/engine.

members.name: getVoidFogYFactor
members.note: csrc/play/play.c sets voidf = 0.03125.

members.name: doesXZShowFog
members.note: Arrives as the rs_in xzfog input; false here.

members.name: getDimensionName
members.note: Abstract display name.

notes: Many providers' constants are inlined at their use sites rather than modelled as a provider struct (servertick.c, renderstate.c, spawning.c, seedworld.c, chunkload.c each branch on dim). getCloudHeight, void particles and void fog were checked only by grep. temple_blocks.c is listed because it restates getAverageGroundLevel as a comment and constant (no symbol cited). Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): the dimension-id branch equals isSurfaceWorld and isSkyColored for the three vanilla providers. Formerly listed as missing: isSurfaceWorld and isSkyColored have no explicit native counterpart; the client renderer branches on the dimension id instead, which matches for the three vanilla providers but is not checked member by member.
